source.snippet: Absolutely love Fastmail. I badly wish that they added a few key enterprise features: mandatory 2FA, SSO, provisioning, and more robust audit logs. If you're reading we would pay for this! Fastmail makes SOC-2 a bit tedious for us to maintain.

problem_statement: Small and mid-size businesses using Fastmail as their email provider cannot achieve SOC-2 compliance easily because Fastmail lacks mandatory 2FA enforcement, SSO integration, user provisioning APIs, and robust audit logs — features standard in enterprise email platforms.
target_segment: SMB and startup IT/security administrators using Fastmail who must maintain SOC-2 or similar compliance certifications
notes: Explicit willingness-to-pay stated ('we would pay for this'). Business context confirmed (SOC-2 maintenance). Gap: a compliance middleware or overlay layer for Fastmail — enforcing 2FA, providing SCIM provisioning, and aggregating audit logs — could be sold as a SaaS add-on to Fastmail customers locked out of enterprise-grade controls.
